notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Aberrant Mind Sorcerer.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Aberrant Mind Sorcerer with haste.
When the Aberrant Mind Sorcerer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and either return Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand, or put Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation if it was put on top of your library.
Repeat.
